H4/1 Å/STO-3G/DF10; common raw ray and Gaussian T_eff hold; V_square residual; Pauli184 vs DF360 rotated Z/ZZ in 10 bases; T=.8/S2/q8/r4/K4; P=0; opt1/seed17.
Assumptions: finite-bit law/angle gap = 0; compiled residual ρ = 0; B engineering-candidate coverage. CONDITIONAL_MATCHED does not establish a representation-only causal
Each arm uses its original Stage3/run04 n=32 prices across all five precisions. G bars: ±1 saved price SE. C comes from the exact price_statistics.json input of Stage4,
not G/N or a new average.
No population ordering, implementation-wide accuracy or finite-bit guarantee. The finite-bit addendum does not update these N/G values or discharge the assumptions.
